parole.testo: From Bulgar, from Arabic بُسْر (busr, “unripe dates”) from the root ب س ر (b s r) related to things being early, so applied to pearls because unripe dates can have some tactile and optical properties similar to pearls.
Of Bulgar origin, from Proto-Turkic *ōtag. Doublet of одая́ (odajá). Probably cognate with Old Church Slavonic ватахъ (vataxŭ, “chief, commander”).
